title: Word search drills
hints: Add `import "slices"`. `slices.Contains(words, w)` and `slices.Index(words, w)` are the whole answers for the first two functions.

`IndexFunc` and `ContainsFunc` take a function `func(string) bool`. Write it inline: `slices.IndexFunc(words, func(w string) bool { return len(w) > n })`. The literal can use `n` because closures capture surrounding variables.
`SameWords` is `slices.Equal(a, b)`. A nil slice and an empty slice both have length 0, so `Equal` treats them as equal.
